run_ddp_training: run distributed data parallel training for semantic segmentation on point cloud data using Hydra config
run_ddp_testing: run distributed testing and evaluation of a trained semantic segmentation model on point cloud datasets
setup_logging: setup logging with stream handler and rank-aware log levels for distributed training processes
main_entry: initialize dataloaders, build the model, load weights, and start training or testing based on config
distributed_main: spawn distributed training processes across multiple GPUs with automatic rank assignment and device binding
